marinara.name: marinara sauce (no sugar added, 24 oz jar)

whitebeans.name: cannellini or great northern beans (15 oz can)

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Egg Bites with Turkey Sausage
recipes.blurb: Your current egg bites, upgraded: blended cottage cheese makes them custardy like the coffee-shop version, and homemade turkey sausage adds real protein.
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F and grease two 12-cup muffin tins well (silicone pans release easiest).

Brown the turkey in a skillet with the maple, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, crushed red pepper, ½ tsp salt, and pepper. Add the bell pepper and spinach for the last 2 minutes, then let it cool a bit.
Blend the eggs, cottage cheese, and remaining ½ tsp salt until completely smooth, about 30 seconds.
Divide the sausage mixture and cheddar among the cups, then pour the egg blend over the top, filling each about ¾ full.
Set a pan of hot water on the rack below and bake 25–30 minutes, until just set in the center. The steam is what keeps them silky instead of spongy.
Cool 10 minutes in the tin before popping them out.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days, or freeze on a sheet pan then bag for up to 2 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 45–60 sec from the fridge, 90 sec from frozen.

recipes.title: Freezer Breakfast Burritos
recipes.blurb: Loaded with turkey sausage, eggs, crispy potatoes, and black beans. Make a dozen and you're covered on the busiest mornings.
steps: Toss the potatoes with the oil and a pinch of salt, then air fry at 400°F for 15–18 minutes, shaking halfway, until crisp.
Meanwhile, brown the turkey with the fajita seasoning in a large skillet. Stir in the black beans and move everything to a big bowl.
Whisk the eggs, egg whites, and remaining salt and pepper. Soft-scramble over medium-low heat and pull them a little early, since they cook more when reheated.
Fold the eggs, potatoes, and cheddar into the turkey mixture and let it cool 10 minutes. Hot filling steams the tortillas and makes them soggy.
Cook the uncooked tortillas per the package, about 30 seconds a side. Add a spoonful of salsa and about ¾ cup filling to each, roll tightly, and wrap in foil or parchment.
Freeze flat in a gallon bag.
recipes.storage: Freezer up to 3 months; fridge 3 days.
recipes.reheat: Unwrap, wrap in a damp paper towel, and microwave 2–2½ min, flipping halfway. For a crisp shell, finish 3 min in the air fryer at 375°F.
recipes.notes: Uncooked tortillas (TortillaLand) are just flour, water, oil, and salt, the closest thing to fresh bread you'll find in a tortilla.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato & Turkey Sausage Hash with Jammy Eggs
recipes.blurb: Sheet-pan sweet potatoes, maple-sage-style turkey sausage, peppers, and pre-peeled jammy eggs. Sweet, savory, and filling.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potatoes, onion, and peppers with the oil and Kinder's veggie rub, then spread across two sheet pans. Roast 25–30 minutes, flipping once, until browned at the edges.
Brown the turkey with the maple, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and crushed red pepper, breaking it into small crumbles. Wilt the spinach in at the end.
Jammy eggs: lower the eggs into boiling water, cook 7 minutes, and move them straight into ice water. Peel once cool.
Toss the roasted vegetables with the turkey and portion into containers. Pack the eggs whole in the corner, or separately.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days. Peeled eggs keep 4 days.
recipes.reheat: Microwave the hash 1½–2 min. Add the egg after reheating, either cold or for 15 seconds, so it doesn't explode or go rubbery.

recipes.title: High-Protein Berry Overnight Oats
recipes.blurb: Ten minutes, zero cooking. Greek yogurt and whey make it creamy and pack 35+ grams into the big jars.
steps: In a big bowl, whisk the yogurt, almond milk, whey, maple, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt until there are no protein lumps.
Stir in the oats and chia.
Divide into 8 jars (4 big, 4 smaller) and top each with frozen berries. They thaw overnight and bleed into the oats.
Refrigerate at least 6 hours.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days. Make Sunday for Mon–Thu.
recipes.reheat: Eat cold, or microwave 1–1½ min and stir if you want warm oats.
recipes.notes: {A}: add 2 hard-boiled eggs or a cheese stick to land at 45 g.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Sheet-Pan Egg Sandwiches
recipes.blurb: A big tray of turkey, spinach, tomato, and feta eggs cut into squares and stacked on toasted sourdough English muffins.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and line a 13×18 sheet pan with parchment that goes up the sides (it releases far better than spray alone).
Brown the turkey with the oregano, garlic powder, and ½ tsp salt.
Blend or whisk the eggs, egg whites, cottage cheese, remaining salt, and pepper until smooth.
Scatter the turkey, spinach, tomatoes, red onion, and feta over the pan, then pour the eggs over evenly.
Bake 18–22 minutes, until the center no longer jiggles. Cool, then cut into 12 squares.
Pack squares with split English muffins. Toast the muffins at eating time if you can.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days. Squares freeze 2 months between sheets of parchment.
recipes.reheat: Square: 45–60 sec in the microwave. Muffin: toaster or 3 min in the air fryer.
recipes.servingLabel: 1 egg square on half an English muffin

source.name: Clemson Extension – Stirring Up Healthy Recipes

recipes.title: Freezer Sausage, Egg & Cheese Sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Better than drive-thru. Homemade turkey sausage patties, baked egg rounds, and sharp cheddar on sourdough English muffins.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Grease a 12-cup muffin tin, or use a parchment-lined 9×13 and cut squares.
Whisk the eggs and egg whites with half the salt and pour into the tin. Bake 15–18 minutes, until set.
Mix the turkey with the maple, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, crushed red pepper, remaining salt, and pepper. Form 12 thin patties a little wider than the muffins, since they shrink.
Cook the patties in a skillet over medium-high, 3 minutes a side.
Build: muffin, patty, egg, cheddar, muffin. Cool completely, then wrap each in parchment and foil.
recipes.reheat: From frozen: unwrap, wrap in a paper towel, and microwave 60–90 sec at 50% power, then 30 sec at full. Or air fry 8 min at 320°F.

recipes.title: Kodiak Cottage Cheese Blender Pancakes
recipes.blurb: Uses the Kodiak mix you already have plus cottage cheese and egg whites. Fluffy, freezable, and 40+ grams in a stack.
steps: Blend the cottage cheese, eggs, egg whites, almond milk, vanilla, and cinnamon until smooth.
Pour into a bowl and fold in the Kodiak mix until just combined. Rest 5 minutes while the pan heats.
Cook ¼-cup scoops on a buttered griddle or nonstick pan over medium-low, about 2 minutes a side. They brown fast because of the cheese.
Cool on a rack, then pack 4 or 2 per container with yogurt and berries in a separate cup.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days; freezer 2 months (freeze flat, then bag).
recipes.reheat: Microwave 45–60 sec, or the toaster from frozen.

recipes.title: Turkey Sausage, Egg & Potato Breakfast Bowls
recipes.blurb: Your breakfast bowls, dialed in: crispy air-fried potatoes, sausage-seasoned turkey, fluffy eggs, cheddar, and salsa on the side.
steps: Toss the potatoes with the oil and Dan-O's, then air fry at 400°F for 18–20 minutes, shaking twice.
Brown the turkey with the maple, garlic powder, paprika, and salt. Add the peppers and onion and cook 5 more minutes.
Whisk the eggs and egg whites and scramble softly in a separate pan, keeping them slightly wet.
Layer potatoes, turkey and pepper mix, and eggs in containers, then top with cheddar. Pack salsa on the side.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 1½–2 min, stirring once. Add salsa after.

recipes.title: Sourdough Sausage & Cheddar Strata
recipes.blurb: The weekend brunch casserole you can actually meal prep. Uses real sourdough, assembles the night before, and bakes Sunday morning.
steps: Brown the turkey with the Weber garlic & herb, paprika, and onion. Wilt in the spinach.
Grease a 9×13 and layer half the bread, half the turkey mix, and half the cheddar. Repeat.
Whisk the eggs, milk, cottage cheese, Dijon, salt, and pepper, then pour over evenly, pressing the bread down so it soaks.
Top with parmesan, cover, and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.
Bake covered at 350°F for 30 minutes, then uncovered 20–25 more, until puffed and set. Rest 10 minutes and cut into 12.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days; freeze individual squares 2 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 1–1½ min, or 6 min in the air fryer at 330°F for crispy edges.

recipes.title: Blueberry Banana Baked Protein Oatmeal
recipes.blurb: Tastes like banana bread, eats like breakfast. Blended cottage cheese and whey keep it moist and high-protein.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and grease a 9×13.
Blend the bananas, cottage cheese, yogurt, eggs, almond milk, maple, and vanilla until smooth.
In a big bowl, stir together the oats, whey, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. Pour in the wet mix and stir well.
Fold in most of the berries, spread in the pan, and scatter the rest on top.
Bake 35–40 minutes, until set and golden at the edges. Cool fully before cutting, or it'll be gummy.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 45–60 sec. Great with a spoon of Greek yogurt on top.
recipes.notes: {A}: add a Greek yogurt cup or 2 eggs on the side to clear 45 g.

recipes.title: Beef Chorizo-Style Egg Muffins
recipes.blurb: Homemade chorizo seasoning on lean ground beef (no mystery-meat sausage) plus green chiles and cheddar. Uses your freezer beef.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease two 12-cup muffin tins.
Brown the beef, then stir in the chili powder, paprika, cumin, oregano, garlic powder, cinnamon, vinegar, and ½ tsp salt. Cook 1 minute until fragrant. Add the bell pepper and green chiles.
Whisk the eggs, egg whites, and remaining salt.
Divide the beef mixture and cheddar among the cups, then pour the eggs over, filling ¾ full.
Bake 20–22 minutes, until set. Top with cilantro.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 45–60 sec. Salsa or hot sauce on top.

recipes.title: Steak & Egg Breakfast Hash Bowls
recipes.blurb: Diner-style steak and eggs: seared sirloin with your Kinder's Prime Steak, crispy potatoes, peppers, and onions.
steps: Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and the Weber garlic parmesan, then air fry at 400°F for 18–20 minutes.

Pat the steak dry and season with the steak seasoning. Sear in a ripping-hot skillet with the remaining oil, 3–4 minutes a side for medium-rare (it'll cook more on reheat). Rest 10 minutes and slice thin against the grain.
In the same pan, cook the peppers and onion until soft and charred, about 6 minutes.
Soft-scramble the eggs with the salt.
Divide potatoes, peppers and onion, eggs, and steak into bowls.
recipes.reheat: Microwave at 70% power for 2 min so the steak doesn't overcook. Hot sauce after.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Protein Pancakes
recipes.blurb: One pan, twelve squares, zero flipping. Kodiak batter with whey and Greek yogurt bakes into fluffy pancakes studded with berries. Reheat a square and top it with more yogurt.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and grease a half-sheet pan.
Whisk the eggs, almond milk, 1 cup yogurt, and vanilla. Stir in the Kodiak mix, whey, and cinnamon until just combined.
Spread in the pan, scatter the berries on top, and bake 15–18 minutes, until the center springs back.
Cool, cut into 12 squares, and pack with the remaining yogurt and a drizzle of maple on the side.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days or freeze up to 2 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 45–60 sec (90 sec from frozen).

ingredients.n: 1 cup in the batter, 2 cups to serve

recipes.title: Pepperoni Pizza Egg Cups
recipes.blurb: Pizza for breakfast, minus the regret. Eggs and cottage cheese bake with turkey pepperoni, mozzarella, peppers, and spinach. Dip them in warm marinara.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease two 12-cup muffin tins (or use silicone liners).
Blend or whisk the eggs, whites, cottage cheese, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, and salt.
Divide the pepperoni, mozzarella, pepper, and spinach among the cups and pour the egg mixture over.
Bake 20–24 minutes, until just set. Cool on a rack so they don't steam.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days or freeze up to 2 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 45 sec for 2 cups. Warm the marinara separately.

recipes.title: Cajun Turkey Sausage Breakfast Scramble
recipes.blurb: Roasted potatoes, turkey sausage, peppers, and onions with fluffy eggs, all hit with Cajun seasoning. A diner skillet you can reheat at your desk.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and 1 tsp Cajun seasoning and roast 25 minutes.
Brown the sausage in a big skillet, breaking it up. Add the peppers, onion, and 1 tsp Cajun and cook until soft.
Whisk the eggs, whites, the last of the Cajun, and salt. Scramble softly in the remaining oil, pulling them off a little wet.
Fold the potatoes, sausage mix, and cheddar together and portion.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 75–90 sec, stirring once.

recipes.title: Steak & Egg White Salsa Breakfast Wraps
recipes.blurb: Seared sirloin, egg whites, spinach, cheddar, and salsa rolled tight and frozen. Grab one on the way out the door.
steps: Season the steak and sear in the oil, 3–4 minutes a side, to medium. Rest 5 minutes and chop small.
Wilt the spinach in the same pan, then add the whites and eggs and scramble until just set.
Cook the tortillas and let them cool. Fill each with eggs, steak, cheddar, and a spoon of well-drained salsa.
Roll tight, wrap in foil or parchment, and freeze what you won't eat in 4 days.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.
recipes.reheat: Unwrap, cover with a damp paper towel, microwave 1 min (2 min from frozen), flipping halfway.

recipes.title: Turkey Sausage Hash Brown Casserole
recipes.blurb: The church-potluck breakfast casserole, made lean. Crispy hash browns, turkey sausage, peppers, cheddar, and a cottage cheese custard that sneaks in extra protein.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and grease a 9×13.
Brown the sausage with the onion and pepper. Spread the hash browns in the dish and top with the sausage mix.
Blend the eggs, milk, cottage cheese, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Pour over and sprinkle with the cheddar.
Bake 40–45 minutes, until set in the middle. Rest 10 minutes before cutting into 12 squares.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days or freeze squares up to 2 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 1–1½ min.

recipes.title: Steak, Sweet Potato & Apple Hash
recipes.blurb: Sweet and savory: roasted sweet potato and apple with cinnamon, seared steak bites, and spinach, plus a jammy egg on each serving.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potato, apple, and onion with 1 tbsp oil, the cinnamon, and salt and roast 25–30 minutes.
Boil the eggs 7 minutes, then ice-bath them and peel.
Season the steak and sear in the remaining oil over high heat, 2–3 minutes. Wilt the spinach in the pan juices.
Toss everything together and portion with an egg each.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days. Keep the eggs whole until you eat them.
recipes.reheat: Microwave the hash 90 sec at 70% power so the steak stays tender. Add the egg after.

recipes.title: Smoked Turkey Sausage Breakfast Skillet
recipes.blurb: Crispy potatoes, smoky turkey kielbasa, peppers, and onions finished with baked eggs right in the skillet. Weekend-brunch energy, weekday convenience.
steps: Microwave the potatoes in a covered bowl for 5 minutes to par-cook.
Brown the kielbasa in the oil in your biggest skillet. Add the potatoes and cook until crisp, 10 minutes, then the peppers, onion, and spices.
Whisk the eggs and whites, pour over, and stir gently over medium-low until just set. Top with cheddar.
Portion into 12 containers (about 1 cup each).
recipes.reheat: Microwave 75–90 sec.

recipes.title: One-Pot Mexican Breakfast Bowls
recipes.blurb: Chorizo-spiced ground turkey simmered with sweet potato, black beans, and fire-roasted tomatoes, topped with eggs. Hearty enough to carry you to lunch.
steps: Brown the turkey with the spices, vinegar, and salt (homemade chorizo).
Add the sweet potato, tomatoes, and ½ cup water. Cover and simmer until tender, 12–15 minutes. Stir in the beans.
Scramble or fry the eggs.
Portion the hash, top each with eggs, cheddar, and cilantro.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 90 sec. Salsa or hot sauce after.

recipes.title: Make-Ahead Freezer Breakfast Quesadillas
recipes.blurb: Eggs, turkey sausage, black beans, cheddar, and salsa folded into tortillas and frozen flat. Ninety seconds in the microwave, or crisp one in a pan.
steps: Brown the sausage and stir in the beans and cumin.
Whisk the eggs and whites with salt and scramble softly.
Cook the tortillas. Cover half of each with eggs, sausage mix, a spoon of salsa, and cheddar, then fold.
Toast in a dry skillet until golden (optional), cool completely, and freeze with parchment between them.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 1 min (90 sec from frozen), or crisp in a skillet 2 min a side.

recipes.title: Sourdough English Muffin Breakfast Bake
recipes.blurb: Torn sourdough English muffins soak up an egg custard with turkey sausage, spinach, and cheddar. It bakes like a strata in half the time.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9×13.
Brown the sausage and wilt the spinach into it.
Spread the muffin pieces in the dish and top with the sausage mix and half the cheddar.
Whisk the eggs, whites, milk, and seasonings and pour over. Press down so the bread soaks, top with the rest of the cheese, and bake 35–40 minutes.
recipes.prep: Assemble it the night before. It bakes better after a soak.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 1 min.

recipes.title: Maple Turkey Sausage Patties & Breakfast Potatoes
recipes.blurb: Homemade breakfast sausage from ground turkey: a touch of maple, sage-y Italian herbs, and a pinch of heat. Served with crispy potatoes and a hard-boiled egg.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and salt and roast 25–30 minutes.
Mix the turkey, maple, and spices with your hands and form 24 small patties.
Cook in batches in the remaining oil, 3 minutes a side, until 165°F.
Hard-boil the eggs (10 minutes) and pack 2 patties, potatoes, and an egg per serving.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days. Patties freeze up to 3 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 60–75 sec.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Crust Quiche
recipes.blurb: Thin sweet potato slices make a naturally sweet, gluten-free crust for a turkey bacon, spinach, and feta quiche. Makes two pies.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Shingle the sweet potato slices in two greased 9-inch pie plates, brush with oil, and bake 15 minutes.
Crisp the turkey bacon, then soften the onion and wilt the spinach in the same pan.
Blend the eggs, whites, cottage cheese, salt, and pepper. Divide the filling and feta between the crusts and pour the eggs over.
Lower to 350°F and bake 35–40 minutes, until just set. Cool 15 minutes and cut each into 6 slices.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days or freeze slices up to 2 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 60–75 sec.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Wraps
recipes.blurb: Seared garlic-parm chicken, crisp romaine, and a Greek-yogurt Caesar dressing that's lighter than the bottle (and has more protein), rolled up in fresh tortillas.
steps: Season the chicken with the garlic parmesan and sear in the oil, 5–6 minutes a side, until 160°F. Rest 5 minutes and slice thin.
Dressing: whisk the yogurt, half the parmesan, the lemon juice, Dijon, Worcestershire, garlic, and pepper. Thin with water to drizzle.
Cook the tortillas per the package and let them cool.
Toss the romaine with half the dressing. Fill each tortilla with lettuce, chicken, the rest of the parmesan, and a drizzle of dressing, then roll tight and wrap in foil.
Or keep the parts separate and roll fresh. It takes two minutes and keeps the lettuce crisp.
recipes.storage: Fridge 2 days rolled, or 4 days with the parts separate.
recipes.reheat: Eat cold.

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Ranch Wraps
recipes.blurb: Spicy buffalo chicken, cool yogurt ranch, cheddar, and crunchy celery. All the wing flavor, packed for lunch.
steps: Season the chicken strips with the kick'n chicken and sear in the oil until cooked through, 6–8 minutes. Toss with the hot sauce while hot.
Ranch: stir the yogurt with the ranch seasoning and a splash of water.
Cook the tortillas and let them cool.
Layer ranch, lettuce, celery, chicken, and cheddar, then roll tight. Or pack the parts separately.
recipes.storage: Fridge 2 days rolled, or 4 days with the parts separate.
recipes.reheat: Eat cold, or warm the chicken 45 sec before rolling.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajita Bowls
recipes.blurb: Everything roasts on one pan (fajita chicken, peppers, onions) and goes over lime rice and black beans. Barely any dishes.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the chicken, peppers, and onion with the oil and fajita seasoning, then spread on a big sheet pan.
Roast 20–22 minutes, then broil 2 minutes for char.
Cook the rice and stir in the lime juice. Warm the beans.
Portion rice, beans, chicken, and veggies. Salsa and yogurt go on the side.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Cheesy Chicken, Rice & Broccoli Boxes
recipes.blurb: The classic gym-bro box, made actually tasty. Dan-O's chicken, garlicky rice, broccoli, and a little melted cheddar on top.
steps: Cook the rice in the broth with the garlic powder instead of water.
Toss the chicken with the Dan-O's and sear in the oil until golden and cooked through, 7–8 minutes.
Steam the broccoli and hit it with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Portion rice, chicken, and broccoli, then sprinkle cheddar on top so it melts when you reheat.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Chicken & Sweet Potato Boxes
recipes.blurb: Bright lemon-garlic chicken with roasted sweet potatoes and green beans. Simple, clean, and good cold or hot.
steps: Marinate the chicken in the lemon juice, 1 tbsp oil, the garlic & herb, oregano, garlic, and half the salt for at least 15 minutes.
Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potatoes with the remaining oil, smoked paprika, and salt and roast 15 minutes.
Add the chicken and green beans to the pan and roast 20 minutes more, until the chicken hits 160°F.
Rest, slice, and portion.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 1½–2 min, or eat cold.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Beef Crunchwraps
recipes.blurb: A better-than-the-drive-thru crunchwrap: seasoned lean beef, cheddar, and a yogurt 'sour cream', folded and air-fried crispy. Uses your freezer beef.
steps: Brown the beef, then stir in the spices, salt, tomato paste, and a splash of water. Simmer until thick.
Lightly cook the tortillas so they're pliable.
Spread yogurt and salsa in the center of each tortilla, add beef and cheddar, then fold the edges in like a pinwheel to seal.
Air fry seam-side down at 380°F for 5–6 minutes, flip, and crisp 3 more.
Add lettuce and tomato at eating time, or tuck them in fresh if you're eating right away.
recipes.reheat: Air fry 6–8 min at 360°F (from frozen, 12 min). The microwave works but loses the crunch.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt Chicken Salad Sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Creamy, tangy chicken salad made with Greek yogurt instead of mayo, plus pickles and celery for crunch, on toasted sourdough. A no-microwave lunch.
steps: Poach the chicken: cover with the broth and water, bring to a simmer, cover, and cook on low 12–15 minutes, until 160°F. Cool and shred or dice.
Mix the yogurt, Dijon, lemon juice, dill, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Fold in the chicken, celery, pickles, and red onion.
Pack the salad separately and build sandwiches on toasted sourdough with lettuce at lunchtime.
recipes.reheat: No reheating. Toast the bread if you can.

recipes.title: Chicken Pesto Pasta Salad
recipes.blurb: A cold pasta salad that actually fills you up: protein pasta, chicken, pesto, tomatoes, mozzarella, and spinach. Tastes better on day two.
steps: Cook the pasta, rinse it under cold water, and drain well.
Season the chicken with the Kinder's wood-fired garlic and sear in the oil until cooked through. Let it cool.
Whisk the pesto, yogurt, and lemon juice.
Toss everything together with the tomatoes, mozzarella, spinach, and parmesan.
recipes.reheat: Eat cold. Give it a stir and a squeeze of lemon if it's dry.

recipes.title: Chicken & Black Bean Quesadillas
recipes.blurb: Fajita-spiced chicken, black beans, peppers, and two cheeses in a crispy tortilla. They freeze great, so make extra.
steps: Cook the chicken with the fajita seasoning in the oil, then add the pepper and onion and cook 4 minutes. Stir in the beans.
Lightly cook the tortillas. On half of each, layer cheese, filling, and more cheese, then fold.
Crisp in a dry skillet 2–3 minutes a side, or air fry at 380°F for 6–8 minutes, flipping once.
Cut in halves. Salsa and yogurt go on the side.
recipes.reheat: Air fry 5 min at 370°F (10 from frozen), or a skillet. The microwave makes them soft.

recipes.title: Greek Chicken Quinoa Salad
recipes.blurb: Lemon-oregano chicken over fluffy quinoa with cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, spinach, and feta. Gets better by day two.
steps: Simmer the quinoa in 3 cups salted water, covered, 15 minutes. Fluff and cool.
Season the chicken with 1 tsp oregano, salt, and 1 tbsp oil. Sear 5–6 minutes a side to 160°F, rest, and dice.
Dressing: the lemon juice, remaining oil and oregano, garlic, and a pinch of salt.
Toss the quinoa, vegetables, and dressing. Portion and top with chicken and feta.
recipes.reheat: Eat cold.

recipes.title: Cranberry Apple Chicken Salad Sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Poached chicken in a tangy Greek-yogurt Dijon dressing with crisp apple, celery, and dried cranberries, piled on sourdough.
steps: Cover the chicken with salted water, bring to a simmer, and poach gently 14–16 minutes to 160°F. Cool and shred or dice.
Stir the yogurt, Dijon, lemon juice, salt, and pepper together.
Fold in the chicken, celery, apple, cranberries, and onion.
Pack the salad separately and build the sandwiches on sourdough with lettuce when you eat them.
recipes.reheat: Eat cold.

recipes.title: Air Fryer BBQ Chicken Tenders with Slaw
recipes.blurb: BBQ-glazed panko tenders straight from the air fryer, with a creamy yogurt coleslaw and sweet potato fries.
steps: Toss the tenders with 3 tbsp BBQ sauce and the rub, then press into the panko-parmesan mix. Mist with oil.
Air fry the fries at 400°F for 15–18 minutes, then the tenders 8–10 minutes, flipping once, until 160°F.
Brush the tenders with the rest of the BBQ sauce.
Slaw: the cabbage mix with yogurt, vinegar, honey, and salt. Pack it separately.
recipes.reheat: Air fry the tenders 4 min at 370°F, or microwave 60 sec.

recipes.title: Mini Steak & Cheese Burritos
recipes.blurb: Philly-meets-burrito. Shaved steak, peppers, and onions with a melty cream-cheese-mozzarella sauce, rolled into small tortillas and frozen.
steps: Soften the peppers and onion in the oil, then push aside and sear the steak with the seasoning and Worcestershire.
Off the heat, stir in the cream cheese and mozzarella until gooey.
Cook the tortillas, fill each with the mixture, and roll tight.
Toast seam-side down in a dry pan (optional), cool, and wrap.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 60 sec (90 sec from frozen) under a damp paper towel.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Cheeseburger Egg Rolls
recipes.blurb: Everything you love about a cheeseburger (beef, cheddar, pickles, mustard) wrapped and air fried crunchy. A Big Mac-style dip makes it.
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and seasoning. Drain, then stir in the mustard, 1 tbsp ketchup, the pickles, and cheddar.
Spoon about ¼ cup onto each wrapper, fold in the sides, and roll tight. Seal the edge with water.
Mist with oil and air fry at 390°F for 8–10 minutes, flipping halfway.
Dip: the yogurt, relish, remaining ketchup, and a squeeze of mustard.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days or freeze (before or after cooking) up to 2 months.
recipes.reheat: Air fry 5 min at 370°F (10 from frozen). The microwave works but softens them.

recipes.title: High-Volume Beef Taco Bowls
recipes.blurb: A big, filling bowl that doesn't blow your macros: seasoned lean beef, a bed of crunchy cabbage, rice, beans, corn, salsa, and lime crema.
steps: Cook the rice. Warm the beans and corn together.
Brown the beef with the spices and ⅓ cup water until saucy.
Lime crema: the yogurt with lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Bowls: cabbage, rice, beans and corn, beef, cheddar. Salsa and crema on the side.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days. Pack the cabbage and salsa separately.
recipes.reheat: Microwave the rice, beef, and beans 90 sec, then add the cold toppings.

recipes.title: Ground Beef & Zucchini Street Corn Bowls
recipes.blurb: Lean beef and charred zucchini over rice with creamy street corn: elote seasoning, lime, feta, and cilantro.
steps: Cook the rice.
Char the corn in a dry hot skillet, then stir in the yogurt, elote seasoning, and lime juice.
Sear the zucchini in the oil until browned, then add the beef and spices and cook through.
Portion rice, beef and zucchini, and street corn. Top with feta and cilantro.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 90 sec (the corn can ride along).

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Mac & Cheese
recipes.blurb: Creamy cheddar protein-pasta mac with shredded buffalo chicken, broccoli, and a ranch finish. Wing night in a lunch container.
steps: Poach or sear the chicken, shred, and toss with 3 tbsp hot sauce.
Boil the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes. Drain.
In the same pot, warm the milk, cream cheese, garlic powder, and ranch until smooth. Melt in the cheddar.
Fold in the pasta, broccoli, chicken, and remaining hot sauce.
recipes.reheat: Splash of milk, microwave 90 sec, stir halfway.

recipes.title: Rosemary Lemon Garlic Chicken Boxes
recipes.blurb: The classic gym-bro lunch done right: juicy rosemary-lemon-garlic chicken with roasted potatoes and garlicky green beans.
steps: Marinate the chicken in the lemon juice, garlic, half the rosemary, 1 tbsp oil, and 1 tsp salt (30 minutes or overnight).
Heat the oven to 425°F. Roast the potatoes with the remaining oil, rosemary, and salt for 20 minutes.
Add the chicken and green beans to the pan and roast 20 minutes more, until the chicken hits 160°F.
Rest, slice, and portion.
recipes.prep: Marinate the chicken.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Cajun Chicken Burritos
recipes.blurb: Cajun-spiced chicken, rice, black beans, peppers, corn, and cheddar with a creamy hot-sauce yogurt. Big burritos built to freeze.
steps: Cook the rice.
Toss the chicken with the Cajun seasoning and sear in the oil. Add the pepper, onion, corn, and beans and cook 4 minutes.
Sauce: the yogurt and hot sauce.
Cook the tortillas, fill with rice, chicken mix, cheddar, and sauce, roll tight, and wrap in foil.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.
recipes.reheat: Unwrap, damp paper towel, microwave 90 sec (3 min from frozen, flipping).

recipes.title: Turkey, Avocado & Egg Wraps
recipes.blurb: Deli turkey, chopped egg, mashed avocado with Dijon yogurt, cheddar, lettuce, and tomato. A no-cook-ish lunch with serious protein.
steps: Hard-boil the eggs (10 minutes), cool, and chop.
Mash the avocado with the yogurt, Dijon, lemon juice, and salt.
Cook the tortillas and let them cool.
Spread with avocado, then layer turkey, cheddar, egg, lettuce, and tomato. Roll tight.
recipes.storage: Fridge 2 days rolled (the lemon keeps the avocado green), or 4 days with the parts separate.
recipes.reheat: Eat cold.

recipes.title: Ground Turkey Fajita Bowls
recipes.blurb: All the sizzle of fajitas with half the work: ground turkey, peppers, and onions in fajita spices over cilantro-lime rice.
steps: Cook the rice and stir in half the lime juice, the cilantro, and salt.
Sear the peppers and onion hard in the oil until charred at the edges. Remove.
Brown the turkey with the fajita seasoning and ¼ cup water, then fold the vegetables back in with the rest of the lime.
Portion over rice with salsa and yogurt.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days. The turkey mix freezes 3 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 90 sec.

recipes.title: One-Pot Chicken & Rice
recipes.blurb: Paprika-cumin chicken simmered right in the rice with carrots and peas. One pot, real flavor, and it reheats perfectly.
steps: Season the chicken with the spices and brown in the oil. Remove.
Soften the onion, carrots, and garlic. Stir in the rice to toast for 1 minute.
Add the broth, bring to a boil, nestle the chicken back in, cover, and simmer on low 15 minutes.
Off the heat, add the peas, cover 5 minutes, then finish with lemon and parsley.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days or freeze up to 2 months.
recipes.reheat: Splash of water, microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Bacon Ranch Chicken & Veggie Packets
recipes.blurb: Ranch-seasoned chicken, potatoes, and broccoli steamed in foil, then finished with turkey bacon and melted cheddar. Nearly no dishes.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Crisp the turkey bacon in a skillet and chop it.
Toss the chicken, potatoes, and broccoli with the oil and ranch seasoning.
Divide among 6 foil squares, seal tight, and bake on a sheet pan 30–35 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
Open the packets, add the cheddar and bacon, and bake 3 minutes more to melt.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger Protein Mac
recipes.blurb: Your house favorite, rebuilt in one pot. Lean beef, protein pasta cooked right in broth, real cheddar, and a Greek-yogurt finish for creaminess without the processed cheese sauce.
steps: Brown the beef and onion in a large pot or deep skillet, about 8 minutes. Season with the burger seasoning, garlic powder, and smoked paprika.
Stir in the tomato paste, mustard, and Worcestershire and cook 1 minute.
Add the broth, milk, and pasta. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook on medium-low 10–12 minutes, stirring every few minutes so nothing sticks, until the pasta is tender.
Take it off the heat. Stir in the cheddar until melted, then the Greek yogurt.
Top with chopped pickles. That's the cheeseburger magic.
recipes.prep: Dice the onion; measure the spices into a small jar.
recipes.reheat: Add a splash of milk and microwave 2 min, stirring halfway.

recipes.title: Big Mac Bowls with Crispy Potatoes
recipes.blurb: All the Big Mac flavor (special sauce, pickles, cheddar, onion) over seasoned beef and air-fried potatoes. A meal-prep crowd favorite.
steps: Toss the potatoes with the oil and Dan-O's, then air fry at 400°F for 18–22 minutes, shaking twice.
Brown the beef with the burger seasoning and onion powder. Drain if needed.
Special sauce: stir together the yogurt, relish, ketchup, mustard, vinegar, paprika, and garlic powder.
Pack the hot side (beef, potatoes, cheddar) in the main container. Pack lettuce, tomato, onion, and pickles cold and separate, with sauce in a small cup.
recipes.prep: Make the special sauce and chop the lettuce, tomato, and onion (keep them separate, in paper-towel-lined containers).
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days, cold toppings packed separately.
recipes.reheat: Microwave the beef and potatoes 1½–2 min, or air fry 5 min at 375°F to re-crisp. Then add the cold stuff and sauce.

recipes.title: Beef Burrito Bowls with Cilantro-Lime Rice
recipes.blurb: Chipotle-style bowls at home: fajita-spiced beef, cilantro-lime rice, black beans, charred corn and peppers, cheese, and a yogurt 'sour cream'.
steps: Cook the rice. When done, fold in the lime juice, half the cilantro, and a pinch of salt.
Brown the beef with the fajita seasoning and a splash of water, simmering until saucy.
In a hot skillet with the oil, char the peppers, onion, and corn for 6–8 minutes.
Warm the black beans with a pinch of salt.
Build bowls: rice, beans, beef, veggies, cheddar. Pack salsa, yogurt, and the rest of the cilantro on the side.
recipes.prep: Cook the rice; slice the peppers and onion.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days; beef and rice freeze 2 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min with a damp paper towel over the rice. Toppings go on after.

recipes.title: Korean-Inspired Beef & Broccoli Rice Bowls
recipes.blurb: The one Asian-leaning dinner in the rotation, and an easy one: sweet-savory garlic-ginger beef over rice with broccoli. On the table in 25 minutes.
steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the beef in a large skillet until crispy in spots. Push it to the side and cook the garlic and ginger in the drippings for 30 seconds.
Stir in the liquid aminos, maple, sesame oil, and crushed red pepper. Simmer 2–3 minutes until glossy.
Steam or microwave the broccoli and carrots until crisp-tender.
Bowls: rice, beef with its sauce, then the vegetables.
recipes.prep: Cook the rice; shred the carrots.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef & Sweet Potato Chili
recipes.blurb: Hearty, smoky, a little sweet from the sweet potatoes. Set it in the morning, and it's even better on day two.
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and pepper. Stir in the chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, jalapeño powder, salt, and tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Scrape everything into the slow cooker with the sweet potatoes, beans, tomatoes, and broth.
Cook on LOW 6–7 hours or HIGH 3–4, until the sweet potatoes are tender.
Taste and adjust the salt. Top with cheddar and yogurt when serving.
recipes.prep: Dice the sweet potatoes and onion. Brown the beef the night before if you want a dump-and-go morning.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2–2½ min, stirring halfway.

recipes.title: Chimichurri Steak & Potato Bowls
recipes.blurb: Seared sirloin with a bright, garlicky chimichurri, crispy roasted potatoes, and green beans. Feels like a steakhouse plate.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and the butcher seasoning, then roast 30–35 minutes. Add the green beans to the pan for the last 12 minutes.
Chimichurri: mix the parsley, garlic, oregano, red wine vinegar, crushed red pepper, salt, and 3 tbsp olive oil (beyond the oil above). Let it sit while you cook.
Pat the steak dry, season with the steak seasoning, and sear in a very hot skillet, 4–5 minutes a side for medium-rare. Rest 10 minutes and slice against the grain.
Bowls: potatoes, green beans, steak. Chimichurri in a small cup.
recipes.prep: Make the chimichurri (it's better after a day) and cut the potatoes into water.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days. Steak is best on days 1–3.
recipes.reheat: Microwave at 70% power 1½–2 min so the steak stays pink. Chimichurri goes on after.

recipes.title: Philly Cheesesteak Stuffed Peppers
recipes.blurb: All the cheesesteak (shaved steak, onions, mushrooms, melty provolone) baked into peppers with a little rice so it's a full meal.
steps: Cook the rice. Heat the oven to 375°F and set the pepper halves cut-side up in a 9×13. Bake them empty for 10 minutes to soften.
Season the steak with the steak seasoning and sear it in batches in a hot skillet with the oil, 1–2 minutes. Set aside.
In the same pan, cook the onion and mushrooms until golden, about 8 minutes. Add the garlic and Worcestershire.
Toss the steak, vegetables, and rice together, then pack into the peppers.
Top each with a provolone slice and bake 15 minutes, until bubbly.
recipes.prep: Cook the rice; slice the onion.
recipes.reheat: Microwave covered, 2–2½ min.

recipes.title: Baked Meatballs Marinara with Protein Pasta
recipes.blurb: Tender beef-and-turkey meatballs baked on a sheet pan (no frying mess), simmered in good marinara, over protein pasta. Double it and freeze half.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Soak the panko in the milk for 2 minutes, then gently mix with the meats, eggs, parmesan, Italian seasoning, garlic, parsley, and salt. Don't overwork it, or the meatballs get tough.
Roll into about 24 balls, a heaping tablespoon each, and bake 15–18 minutes.
Simmer the marinara, add the meatballs, and let them hang out 5 minutes.
Cook the pasta 1 minute short of the package time. Portion pasta, meatballs, and sauce, then top with mozzarella.
recipes.prep: Mix and roll the meatballs and refrigerate them on the pan, ready to bake.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days; meatballs in sauce freeze 3 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min. Add a splash of water if the pasta looks dry.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Shepherd's Pie
recipes.blurb: Savory beef and veggie filling under a creamy sweet potato mash with a cheddar crust. Cozy, and freezes perfectly.
steps: Boil the sweet potatoes in salted water 15 minutes, until very tender. Drain and mash with the yogurt, butter, and ½ tsp salt.
Meanwhile, brown the beef with the onion and carrots. Add the garlic, tomato paste, Worcestershire, Italian seasoning, and remaining salt and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the broth and simmer 8 minutes, until thick. Stir in the peas.
Spread the filling in a 9×13, spoon the mash over, and sprinkle with cheddar.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes, then broil 2 minutes for color.
recipes.prep: Peel and cube the sweet potatoes; dice the onion and carrots.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2–2½ min.

recipes.title: Beef Gyro Bowls with Tzatziki & Lemon Rice
recipes.blurb: Gyro-spiced crispy beef, lemony rice, homemade tzatziki, and a crunchy cucumber-tomato-feta salad. Fresh and filling.
steps: Cook the rice and stir in 1 tbsp lemon juice.
Brown the beef in a hot skillet. Let it sit undisturbed so it crisps, then season with the oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Tzatziki: squeeze the grated cucumber dry in a towel and mix with the yogurt, minced garlic, dill, the remaining lemon juice, and a pinch of salt.
Salad: toss the diced cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, and feta with the vinegar and oil.
Pack the rice and beef warm. Salad and tzatziki go in separate cups.
recipes.prep: Make the tzatziki and chop the salad (dress it day-of); cook the rice.
recipes.reheat: Microwave the rice and beef 1½–2 min. Salad and tzatziki stay cold.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef Barbacoa Bowls
recipes.blurb: Fall-apart chipotle-lime beef, the copycat everyone loves. Pile it on rice with beans and crunchy slaw.
steps: Blend the chipotles, adobo, lime juice, vinegar, garlic, cumin, oregano, salt, pepper, and broth into a smooth sauce.
Put the beef in the slow cooker and pour the sauce over. Cook on LOW 8 hours, until it shreds easily.
Shred with two forks and stir it back into the juices. This keeps it moist for days.
Cook the rice. Bowls: rice, beans, barbacoa with a spoon of juice, and slaw with cilantro and a squeeze of lime.
recipes.prep: Blend the sauce and refrigerate it with the beef so it's dump-and-go in the morning.
recipes.storage: Fridge 5 days; shredded beef freezes 3 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min. Keep the slaw separate.
recipes.notes: Want it milder? Use 1 chipotle and skip the adobo.

recipes.title: Sourdough Smash Patty Melts & Potato Wedges
recipes.blurb: Your burger night, perfected. Smashed lean patties, jammy onions, and cheddar griddled between sourdough, plus air-fried wedges. Prep ahead, griddle fresh.
steps: Caramelize the onions in 1 tbsp butter over medium-low heat, 20–25 minutes, with a pinch of salt. Do this on prep day.
Air fry the wedges, tossed with the oil and Dan-O's, at 400°F for 18–20 minutes.
Sauce: yogurt, ketchup, relish, and Dijon.
Smash the beef balls thin onto a screaming-hot skillet, season with the burger seasoning, cook 2 minutes, flip, and add cheese.
Build on sourdough with sauce and onions, then griddle in the remaining butter until golden, 2–3 minutes a side.
For tomorrow's lunch, pack the patties, onions, and bread separately and assemble fresh.
recipes.prep: Caramelize the onions; portion the beef into balls; cut the wedges into water.
recipes.reheat: Rebuild the melt and air fry 5–6 min at 360°F. It's way better than a microwave here.

recipes.title: Turkey Taco Sweet Potato Skillet
recipes.blurb: One skillet: taco-spiced turkey, tender sweet potatoes, black beans, and corn under melty cheddar. Big flavor, minimal dishes.
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion and pepper in a large lidded skillet. Add the spices and salt.
Stir in the sweet potatoes, tomatoes, and broth. Cover and simmer 15–18 minutes, until the potatoes are fork-tender.
Stir in the beans and corn and heat through.
Top with cheddar, cover 2 minutes to melt, then finish with cilantro and lime.
recipes.prep: Dice the sweet potatoes, onion, and pepper.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Greek Turkey Burger Bowls
recipes.blurb: Juicy turkey patties with feta and spinach mixed right in, so they never dry out, over rice with tzatziki and tomatoes.
steps: Gently mix the turkey, feta, spinach, grated onion, oregano, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Form 12 small patties.
Sear in the oil over medium-high, 4–5 minutes a side, until they hit 165°F.
Cook the rice.
Quick tzatziki: squeeze the grated cucumber dry and mix with the yogurt, lemon juice, dill, and a pinch of salt.
Bowls: rice, patties, sliced cucumber, tomatoes. Tzatziki on the side.
recipes.prep: Mix and form the patties (separate them with parchment); cook the rice; make the tzatziki.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days; cooked patties freeze 2 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 1½–2 min.

recipes.title: Turkey Bolognese with Protein Pasta
recipes.blurb: A slow-simmered meat sauce with carrot, celery, and a splash of milk for that classic silky texture. Makes Sunday smell amazing.
steps: Cook the onion, carrot, and celery in the oil until soft, about 8 minutes.
Add the turkey and break it up very fine. Brown it, then add the garlic and tomato paste and cook 2 minutes.
Splash in the vinegar, then the crushed tomatoes, Italian seasoning, salt, and red pepper. Simmer uncovered 30 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the milk and simmer 5 more minutes.
Toss with the cooked pasta and top with parmesan.
recipes.prep: Finely dice the onion, carrot, and celery (or pulse them in the food processor).
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min with a splash of water.

recipes.title: Classic Turkey Chili
recipes.blurb: A proper thick, beefy-tasting chili that happens to be turkey. Serve over rice or a baked sweet potato.
steps: Brown the turkey in the oil and break it up well. Add the onion and peppers and cook 6 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, spices, salt, and tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans, and broth. Simmer partly covered 30 minutes, until thick.
Cook the rice. Serve the chili over it with cheddar and yogurt.
recipes.prep: Dice the onion and peppers; cook the rice.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2–2½ min.

recipes.title: Italian Turkey Stuffed Peppers
recipes.blurb: Classic stuffed peppers: Italian-seasoned turkey, rice, and tomatoes under a melty mozzarella lid.
steps: Cook the rice. Heat the oven to 375°F and pre-bake the pepper halves 10 minutes.
Brown the turkey with the onion, garlic, Italian seasoning, and salt.
Stir in the tomatoes, tomato paste, and rice and simmer 5 minutes.
Fill the peppers, top with mozzarella and parmesan, cover with foil, and bake 20 minutes. Uncover for 5 more.
recipes.prep: Cook the rice; halve and seed the peppers.
recipes.reheat: Microwave covered 2–2½ min.

recipes.title: One-Pot Creamy Turkey Taco Pasta
recipes.blurb: Taco night meets mac and cheese. Turkey, salsa, green chiles, and protein pasta cooked together, then finished creamy with cheddar.
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion and pepper, then add the spices and salt.
Add the salsa, tomatoes, chiles, broth, and pasta. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer 10–12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender.
Off the heat, stir in the cream cheese, then the cheddar. Top with cilantro.
recipes.prep: Dice the onion and pepper.
recipes.reheat: Splash of water or broth and microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Turkey Sloppy Joes on Toasted Sourdough
recipes.blurb: Homemade sauce (no canned stuff): tangy, a little sweet, piled on toasted sourdough with sweet potato fries.
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion and pepper. Add the garlic and tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, Worcestershire, vinegar, maple, mustard, chili powder, and salt. Simmer 10 minutes, until thick and glossy.
Toss the sweet potato fries with the oil and paprika and air fry at 400°F for 15–18 minutes.
Toast the sourdough. Pile on the joe and top with cheddar.
recipes.prep: Make the sloppy joe filling entirely (it's better the next day); cut the fries.
recipes.reheat: Microwave the filling 1½ min; toast the bread fresh; air fry the fries 4 min.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma Bowls with Garlic Yogurt Sauce
recipes.blurb: Warm-spiced, yogurt-marinated chicken roasted until the edges char, over rice with cucumber-tomato salad and a garlicky white sauce.
steps: Marinate the chicken in ¼ cup yogurt, 2 tbsp lemon juice, the oil, all the spices, half the minced garlic, and 1 tsp salt. Give it at least 30 minutes, or overnight.
Roast on a sheet pan at 425°F for 20–25 minutes, then broil 2–3 minutes to char. Rest and slice.
Sauce: 1 cup yogurt, the remaining garlic and lemon juice, and a pinch of salt.
Cook the rice. Bowls: rice, chicken, cucumber, tomato, red onion, and sauce on the side.
recipes.prep: Marinate the chicken; cook the rice; chop the salad.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days; cooked chicken freezes 2 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave the rice and chicken 1½–2 min. The salad and sauce stay cold.
recipes.notes: Breasts work too. Pull them at 160°F so they stay juicy.

ingredients.n: ¼ cup for marinade, 1 cup for sauce

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Bowls with Yogurt Ranch
recipes.blurb: Wing-night flavor on a weekday: buffalo-tossed chicken, crispy potatoes, broccoli, and a cool homemade ranch using your ranch seasoning.
steps: Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and garlic powder and air fry at 400°F for 18–20 minutes.
Season the chicken with the kick'n chicken and remaining oil. Roast at 425°F for 15–18 minutes (or air fry in batches, 10 minutes). Roast the broccoli on the same pan.
Melt the butter into the hot sauce and toss with the hot chicken.
Ranch: yogurt, ranch seasoning, and milk to thin.
Bowls: potatoes, broccoli, buffalo chicken, celery. Ranch on the side.
recipes.prep: Cube the chicken and season it; make the ranch.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min, or air fry 5 min at 375°F to re-crisp.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Salsa Chicken Burrito Bowls
recipes.blurb: Two ingredients do the heavy lifting: chicken plus salsa in the slow cooker equals juicy shredded chicken for bowls all week.
steps: Put the chicken in the slow cooker, sprinkle with the fajita seasoning, and pour the salsa over. Cook LOW 4–5 hours or HIGH 2½–3.
Shred right in the pot and stir in the lime juice. Let it soak up the juices for 10 minutes.
Cook the rice and stir in half the cilantro.
Bowls: rice, beans, corn, chicken, and cheddar. Yogurt and avocado added fresh.
recipes.prep: Load the slow cooker insert and refrigerate it overnight; cook the rice.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days; shredded chicken freezes 3 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Creamy Tuscan Chicken Protein Pasta
recipes.blurb: Sun-dried tomatoes, garlic, spinach, and parmesan in a light creamy sauce (cream cheese and milk, no heavy cream) with seared chicken.
steps: Cook the pasta 1 minute short of the package time. Save ½ cup of the pasta water.
Season the chicken with the garlic parmesan and Italian seasoning. Sear in the oil 6–7 minutes until golden and cooked through, then set aside.
In the same pan, cook the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute. Add the broth and scrape up the browned bits.
Whisk in the milk and cream cheese until smooth, then the parmesan. Simmer 2 minutes.
Wilt in the spinach, add the chicken, red pepper, and pasta, and loosen with pasta water as needed.
recipes.prep: Cube and season the chicken; chop the sun-dried tomatoes.
recipes.reheat: Splash of milk and microwave 2 min, stirring halfway.

recipes.title: BBQ Chicken & Sweet Potato Bowls with Crunchy Slaw
recipes.blurb: Uses your BBQ rub and sauce collection. Rubbed, sauced, and caramelized chicken, roasted sweet potatoes and corn, and a tangy yogurt slaw.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potatoes with the oil, smoked paprika, and a pinch of salt and roast 25–30 minutes. Add the corn for the last 10.
Rub the chicken with the BBQ rub and roast on a second pan 15 minutes. Brush with half the BBQ sauce and roast 8–10 more, until caramelized.
Slaw: toss the cabbage with the yogurt, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and salt.
Slice the chicken and toss with the remaining sauce. Bowls: sweet potatoes, corn, chicken. Slaw packed separately.
recipes.prep: Cube the sweet potatoes; rub the chicken; make the slaw dressing.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min. Slaw stays cold.

recipes.title: Chicken Pesto Protein Pasta
recipes.blurb: Bright and fast. Seared chicken, protein pasta, pesto lightened with Greek yogurt, burst cherry tomatoes, and spinach.
steps: Cook the pasta and save ½ cup of the water.
Season the chicken with the Kinder's wood-fired garlic and sear in the oil until cooked through.
Add the tomatoes to the pan and cook until they blister and pop, about 4 minutes. Wilt in the spinach.
Stir the pesto, yogurt, and lemon together, then toss with the pasta, chicken mix, and splashes of pasta water.
Top with parmesan and mozzarella.
recipes.prep: Cube and season the chicken.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days. Also good cold, like a pasta salad.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 1½ min, or eat cold.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.blurb: Yogurt-marinated chicken charred under the broiler, then simmered in a rich, warmly spiced tomato sauce. Lighter than takeout, just as good.
steps: Marinate the chicken with ½ cup yogurt, half the spices, half the garlic and ginger, and 1 tsp salt (30 minutes to overnight).
Spread on a foil-lined sheet pan and broil 8–10 minutes, until charred in spots.
Melt the butter and cook the onion until golden, about 8 minutes. Add the remaining garlic, ginger, and spices and cook 1 minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes. Whisk in the cream cheese and the remaining ½ cup yogurt off the heat so it doesn't split.
Add the chicken and simmer 5 minutes. Serve over rice with cilantro.
recipes.prep: Marinate the chicken; cook the rice; dice the onion.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

ingredients.n: ½ for marinade, ½ for sauce

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Honey Garlic Chicken, Potatoes & Green Beans
recipes.blurb: Sticky honey-garlic glaze, crispy potatoes, and green beans, all on one pan. Minimal effort, big reward.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and the Weber garlic & herb and roast 15 minutes.
Season the chicken with the Kinder's all-purpose. Push the potatoes aside, add the chicken and green beans tossed in the remaining oil, and roast 18–20 minutes.
Glaze: simmer the honey, aminos, garlic, vinegar, Dijon, and red pepper for 2 minutes.
Brush the glaze on the chicken and broil 2 minutes until sticky.
recipes.prep: Cut the potatoes; mix the glaze.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.
recipes.notes: Also great with chicken breasts. Use them to burn through freezer stock.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchilada Rice Skillet
recipes.blurb: Everything you love about enchiladas (red sauce, beans, corn, gooey cheese) without rolling a single tortilla. The rice cooks right in the pan.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil with the cumin, chili powder, and salt. Set aside.
Cook the onion and pepper 4 minutes, then stir in the rice and toast 1 minute.
Add the enchilada sauce and broth, bring to a boil, cover, and simmer on low 18–20 minutes, until the rice is tender.
Stir in the chicken, beans, and corn, cover with cheddar, and lid it until melted. Finish with cilantro and yogurt.
recipes.prep: Cube the chicken; dice the onion and pepper.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min with a splash of water.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Parm Meatballs with Protein Pasta
recipes.blurb: Chicken parm in meatball form, with parmesan and garlic in the mix, baked in marinara under bubbling mozzarella.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Mix the chicken, egg, parmesan, panko, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, and salt, and roll into about 24 meatballs. Wet hands help, since the mix is sticky.
Bake on a parchment-lined pan 15 minutes.
Move them to a baking dish, pour the marinara over, top with mozzarella, and bake 10 more minutes until bubbly.
Serve over cooked pasta with parsley.
recipes.prep: Roll the meatballs.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days; meatballs in sauce freeze 3 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.
recipes.notes: Want to use freezer breasts? Pulse 2 lb cubed breast in a food processor. Add 1 tbsp olive oil, since breast is leaner.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Greek Chicken & Lemon Potatoes
recipes.blurb: Lemon, garlic, and oregano chicken with crispy lemony potatoes and peppers, plus tzatziki and feta. A Mediterranean classic.
steps: Marinate the chicken in 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp oil, half the oregano, the garlic, and 1 tsp salt.
Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil, the remaining oregano, garlic powder, and salt, and roast 20 minutes.
Add the chicken, onion, pepper, and zucchini (tossed in the last of the oil) and roast 20–22 minutes, until the chicken hits 160°F.
Tzatziki: the yogurt, squeezed cucumber, dill, the remaining lemon juice, and salt.
Slice the chicken and portion with the vegetables. Feta on top, tzatziki on the side.
recipes.prep: Marinate the chicken; cut the potatoes and vegetables; make the tzatziki.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Crispy Chicken Sandwiches on Sourdough
recipes.blurb: Your chicken sandwich night, leveled up. Yogurt-and-pickle-brined breast with a parmesan-panko crust, air fried crunchy, plus hot-honey sauce and sweet potato fries.
steps: Brine: coat the cutlets in ½ cup yogurt, the pickle juice, 1 tbsp hot sauce, and the kick'n chicken. Give it 30 minutes to overnight.
Mix the panko, parmesan, and paprika and press firmly onto the chicken. Mist with oil.
Air fry at 400°F for 10–12 minutes, flipping halfway, until 160°F inside. Do the fries first (15–18 minutes), since they hold well.
Hot-honey sauce: ¼ cup yogurt, 1 tbsp hot sauce, and the honey.
Build on toasted sourdough with lettuce, tomato, and pickles. For lunch, pack the cutlet separately.
recipes.prep: Brine the chicken; cut the fries.
recipes.reheat: Air fry the cutlet 5 min at 370°F. The microwave makes it soggy. Toast the bread fresh.

ingredients.n: ½ cup brine, ¼ cup sauce

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan BBQ Chicken & Veggies
recipes.blurb: Rub-seasoned chicken lacquered in BBQ sauce, roasted with sweet potatoes, broccoli, and red onion on one pan.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potatoes and onion with 1 tbsp oil and salt and roast 15 minutes.
Rub the chicken with the BBQ rub and the rest of the oil. Add it and the broccoli to the pan.
Roast 18–20 minutes, brushing the chicken with BBQ sauce in the last 5, until 160°F.
Slice and portion.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Bruschetta Chicken
recipes.blurb: Italian-herb chicken roasted with potatoes and green beans, then topped with melty mozzarella and a fresh garlicky tomato bruschetta.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Roast the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and salt for 15 minutes.
Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, garlic powder, salt, and 1 tbsp oil. Add it and the green beans and roast 18 minutes.
Top the chicken with mozzarella and parmesan and roast 3 minutes more.
Bruschetta: the tomatoes, onion, garlic, vinegar, last of the oil, and a pinch of salt. Spoon over (or pack separately).
recipes.reheat: Microwave the chicken and veg 2 min, then add the cold bruschetta.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Chicken Parmesan with Protein Pasta
recipes.blurb: Crunchy panko-parm cutlets from the air fryer, smothered in marinara and mozzarella over protein spaghetti. No frying oil.
steps: Dip the cutlets in beaten egg, then press into the panko, parmesan, Italian seasoning, and garlic powder. Mist with oil.
Air fry at 400°F for 10 minutes, flipping halfway. Top each with marinara and mozzarella and air fry 2 minutes more.
Boil the pasta and toss with the remaining warm marinara.
Portion the pasta with a cutlet each.
recipes.reheat: Microwave the pasta 90 sec. Air fry the cutlet 4 min at 370°F to keep the crunch.

recipes.title: Herb-Roasted Chicken Thighs & Root Vegetables
recipes.blurb: Garlic-herb chicken thighs roasted over potatoes, carrots, and onion so the vegetables soak up all the juices. Sunday-dinner flavor, Tuesday effort.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the vegetables with 1 tbsp oil, half the rosemary, and salt in a roasting pan. Pour in the broth.
Season the thighs with the garlic & herb, remaining rosemary, salt, and oil. Nestle them on top.
Roast 35–40 minutes, until the thighs reach 175°F and the vegetables are tender.
Squeeze lemon over and portion.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheddar Stuffed Chicken & Rice Pilaf
recipes.blurb: Chicken breasts stuffed with a cheesy broccoli filling and baked golden, with a buttery garlic rice pilaf.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Mix the broccoli, cheddar, cream cheese, ½ tsp garlic powder, and a pinch of salt.
Cut a deep pocket in each breast, stuff, and close with toothpicks. Rub with oil, paprika, the rest of the garlic powder, and salt.
Bake 25–28 minutes, to 160°F.
Pilaf: soften the onion in the butter, toast the rice, add the broth, and simmer covered 15 minutes.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: BBQ Pulled Chicken Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
recipes.blurb: Set-and-forget BBQ pulled chicken spooned into roasted sweet potatoes with cheddar and a tangy yogurt slaw.
steps: Slow cooker: chicken, the rub, 6 tbsp BBQ sauce, 1 tbsp vinegar, and ¼ cup water. Low 4 hours (or high 2½). Shred in the sauce.
Bake the sweet potatoes at 425°F for 45–50 minutes, until soft (or microwave 8–10 minutes).
Slaw: the cabbage, yogurt, last of the vinegar, and salt.
Split the potatoes and fill with chicken, the rest of the BBQ sauce, and cheddar. Slaw on the side.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days. Pulled chicken freezes 3 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave the potato and chicken 2 min.

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Stuffed Peppers
recipes.blurb: Shredded buffalo chicken, rice, and a creamy ranch filling baked in bell pepper boats under mozzarella. Celery on top for crunch.
steps: Poach or bake the chicken and shred. Cook the rice.
Mix the chicken, rice, hot sauce, cream cheese, ranch, and salt.
Heat the oven to 375°F. Fill the pepper halves, cover with foil, and bake 25 minutes.
Uncover, add the mozzarella, and bake 10 minutes more. Top with celery.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days or freeze up to 2 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2–2½ min.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Moroccan Chicken
recipes.blurb: Warmly spiced (cumin, cinnamon, paprika, turmeric, not hot) chicken thighs braised with tomatoes, carrots, and a touch of honey over rice.
steps: Add everything except the rice, lemon, and parsley to the slow cooker.
Cook on low 5 hours (or high 3), until the chicken pulls apart.
Cook the rice.
Shred the chicken into the sauce, stir in the lemon, and serve over rice with parsley.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Three-Cheese Chicken Alfredo
recipes.blurb: A blended cottage cheese, parmesan, and mozzarella sauce that tastes like full-fat alfredo, with garlic-parm chicken, broccoli, and protein pasta.
steps: Season the chicken with the garlic parmesan and sear in the oil to 160°F. Rest and slice.
Boil the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes. Save ½ cup pasta water.
Blend the cottage cheese, milk, parmesan, and garlic until silky. Warm gently in the pot and melt in the mozzarella.
Toss in the pasta and broccoli, loosening with pasta water. Top with chicken and pepper.
recipes.reheat: Add a splash of milk and microwave 90 sec, stirring halfway.

recipes.title: High-Protein White Chicken Chili
recipes.blurb: Creamy (but light) chili with chicken, white beans, green chiles, corn, and cumin. Cozy, mild, and built for the freezer.
steps: Soften the onion, jalapeño, and garlic in the oil. Add the spices.
Add the whole chicken breasts, chiles, beans, and broth. Simmer covered 20–25 minutes.
Remove the chicken and shred. Mash a cup of the beans against the pot to thicken.
Stir in the chicken, corn, and cream cheese until creamy. Finish with lime and cilantro.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2–2½ min, stirring once.

recipes.title: Creamy Penne alla Vodka with Chicken
recipes.blurb: A blush tomato cream sauce lightened with cream cheese and parmesan, tossed with protein penne and seared chicken. Vodka optional.
steps: Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning and salt and sear in the oil. Remove.
Soften the onion and garlic, then fry the tomato paste 1 minute (add a splash of vodka here if you have it).
Add the crushed tomatoes and red pepper and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in the cream cheese, milk, and parmesan.
Toss with the cooked penne and chicken.
recipes.reheat: Splash of water, microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Marry Me Chicken with Rice
recipes.blurb: The viral one. Golden chicken in a creamy sun-dried tomato parmesan sauce with spinach, over rice. Proposal not guaranteed.
steps: Cook the rice.
Season the cutlets and sear in the oil, 3–4 minutes a side. Remove.
Sauté the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes, add the broth, and scrape up the browned bits. Whisk in the cream cheese, milk, and parmesan.
Wilt in the spinach, return the chicken, and simmer 3 minutes. Serve over rice.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Chicken Florentine Pasta
recipes.blurb: Seared chicken, garlicky mushrooms, and lots of spinach in a lemony parmesan cream sauce, tossed with protein pasta.
steps: Season and sear the chicken to 160°F. Rest and slice.
Brown the mushrooms in the same pan, add the garlic, then the broth.
Whisk in the cream cheese, parmesan, and lemon. Wilt in the spinach.
Toss with the cooked pasta and chicken.
recipes.reheat: Splash of water, microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken Gnocchi Soup
recipes.blurb: The Olive Garden favorite, lightened: chicken, pillowy gnocchi, carrots, celery, and spinach in a creamy broth.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil. Add the onion, carrots, celery, and garlic and cook 5 minutes.
Add the broth and seasonings and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the gnocchi and cook until they float, 3–4 minutes.
Stir in the milk, cream cheese, and spinach until creamy. Top with parmesan.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days. (Gnocchi gets soft when frozen, so don't.)
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min, stirring once.

recipes.title: Garlic Herb Beef Meatballs with Roasted Potatoes
recipes.blurb: Lean, tender, high-protein meatballs (the secret is parmesan and grated onion) roasted on a sheet pan with potatoes and green beans. Yogurt-herb dip on the side.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Roast the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and salt for 15 minutes.
Mix the beef, egg, panko, parmesan, onion, garlic, Italian seasoning, and 1 tsp salt. Roll 30 meatballs.
Add the meatballs and green beans (tossed in the last oil) to the pan and roast 15–18 minutes, to 160°F.
Dip: the yogurt, dill, lemon, and a pinch of salt.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Hearty Beef & Bean Soup
recipes.blurb: A budget, stick-to-your-ribs soup: lean beef, two kinds of beans, tomatoes, vegetables, and spinach. Freezes perfectly.
steps: Brown the beef. Add the onion, carrots, celery, and garlic and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the spices, then the tomatoes, broth, and beans.
Simmer 25–30 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2–2½ min.

recipes.title: Beefy Cottage Cheese Enchiladas
recipes.blurb: Saucy beef enchiladas with a creamy cottage cheese filling standing in for sour cream and extra cheese. More protein, same comfort.
steps: Brown the beef with the onion, chiles, and spices. Stir in the cottage cheese and ½ cup enchilada sauce.
Heat the oven to 375°F. Spread ½ cup sauce in a 9×13.
Cook the tortillas briefly, fill each with the beef mix, roll, and line them up seam-side down.
Pour the rest of the sauce over, top with cheddar, cover, and bake 20 minutes, then 5 uncovered. Cilantro on top.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: High-Protein Creamy Taco Soup
recipes.blurb: Taco night as a creamy soup: lean beef, beans, corn, and fire-roasted tomatoes, made silky with blended cottage cheese. Top it with cheddar.
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and spices.
Add the tomatoes, beans, corn, and broth. Simmer 15 minutes.
Blend the cottage cheese and cream cheese with a ladle of hot broth until smooth, then stir it back in.
Finish with lime. Top with cheddar.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days or freeze up to 2 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min, stirring once.

recipes.title: Ground Beef & Spinach Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
recipes.blurb: Smoky paprika beef and spinach piled into roasted sweet potatoes with feta and a garlic yogurt drizzle.
steps: Bake the sweet potatoes at 425°F for 45–50 minutes (or microwave 8–10).
Brown the beef with the onion, half the garlic, and the spices. Wilt in the spinach.
Sauce: the yogurt, remaining garlic, lemon, and a pinch of salt.
Split the potatoes, fill with the beef, and top with feta and sauce.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Bacon Cheeseburger Potato Casserole
recipes.blurb: A whole cheeseburger in casserole form: lean beef, sliced potatoes, turkey bacon, pickles, and a cheddar custard. Top with ketchup and mustard.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Microwave the potato slices covered for 5 minutes and layer them in a greased 9×13.
Crisp the turkey bacon and chop. Brown the beef with the onion and burger seasoning.
Whisk the eggs, milk, mustard, and ketchup and stir into the beef with half the cheddar. Spread over the potatoes.
Top with the rest of the cheddar and the bacon and bake 25 minutes. Scatter pickles on top.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days or freeze up to 2 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Oven-Baked Beef & Bean Tacos
recipes.blurb: Crispy, cheesy tacos baked all at once on a sheet pan: seasoned lean beef and mashed black beans in toasted tortillas.
steps: Brown the beef with the spices and tomato paste and ⅓ cup water. Stir in the mashed beans.
Heat the oven to 425°F. Brush the cooked tortillas with oil and drape them over the oven rack (or stand them in a pan) for 5 minutes to set.
Fill the shells with the beef and cheddar, stand them in a baking dish, and bake 8–10 minutes until crisp and melty.
Top with lettuce, tomato, salsa, and yogurt.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days. Store the filling and shells separately.
recipes.reheat: Microwave the filling 90 sec and fill fresh, or re-crisp the shells in the oven or air fryer.

recipes.title: High-Protein Creamy Lasagna Soup
recipes.blurb: All the lasagna flavor without the layering: beef and turkey in a tomato broth with protein pasta, topped with a cottage cheese and mozzarella dollop.
steps: Brown the beef and turkey with the onion and garlic. Stir in the seasonings and tomato paste.
Add the crushed tomatoes and broth and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook until tender, 9–11 minutes. Stir in the spinach.
Mix the cottage cheese, mozzarella, and parmesan and dollop on each bowl (pack it separately for meal prep).
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days. The pasta soaks up broth, so add water when reheating.
recipes.reheat: Splash of water, microwave 2 min, then add the cheese dollop.

recipes.title: Tuscan White Bean & Turkey Sausage Soup
recipes.blurb: Homemade Italian-spiced turkey sausage simmered with white beans, potatoes, and spinach in a garlicky broth with a parmesan finish.
steps: Season the turkey with the Italian seasoning, red pepper, garlic powder, and 1 tsp salt (instant sausage) and brown in the oil.
Add the onion and garlic, then the potatoes and broth. Simmer 15 minutes.
Add the beans and simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and milk. Finish with parmesan.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Italian Wedding Soup with Turkey Meatballs
recipes.blurb: Tiny parmesan turkey meatballs, carrots, celery, spinach, and small pasta in a golden broth. Comfort in a bowl.
steps: Mix the turkey, egg, panko, half the parmesan, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, and ½ tsp salt. Roll into small 1-inch meatballs.
Soften the onion, carrots, and celery in the oil. Add the broth and bring to a simmer.
Drop in the meatballs and pasta and simmer 10–12 minutes, until both are cooked.
Stir in the spinach and serve with the remaining parmesan.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.
